name: Oliver Renwick
summary: Oliver Renwick's personal site. No public source for this build was found; the author's older personal-site repository is a different build. Its home page loads only its own files, but the talk pages embed YouTube players that load as the page opens, third-party code the reader did not ask for, so it stays Level 2.

connections.note: Embedded on the talk pages; loaded as each page opens.
